basic_details.job_title: Burari Hospital Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 16 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Burari Hospital (Govt. of NCT of Delhi) will hold walk-in interviews for Senior Residents on an ad-hoc basis on every Friday from 30 October 2026 to 20 November 2026. Candidates must report between 9 AM and 11 AM at the Office of Medical Director, Burari Hospital, Kaushik Enclave, Burari, Delhi-110084. There are 16 posts: 10 in OBG and 6 in Gen. Surgery. Pay will follow the 7th CPC guidelines as adopted by GNCT of Delhi. Before the interview, candidates must fill in the online application form.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form through the Google Form link given in the notice, or by scanning the "QR Code for Registration" printed in it. The link is valid from the date the advertisement is published.
Submit the form carefully. Right after you submit it, you will receive an auto-generated email.
If the email does not arrive, check your trash/spam folder.
The auto-generated email contains your prefilled application form, based on the details you submitted. Print it out.
Bring the printout to the walk-in interview on any of the scheduled Fridays, along with the photographs, photocopies and original documents listed below.
Queries can be sent to [email protected].
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for taking part in the selection process. Every appointment will be subject to medical fitness and to verification of certificates of educational qualification, age and caste, and submission of a valid DMC post-graduation registration certificate. If any declaration or information is found to be false, or any fact is wilfully hidden, the candidature or appointment will be cancelled or terminated at once. Administrative or legal action will follow, and the Delhi Medical Council will also be informed. Candidature will be rejected if any discrepancy is found in documents or information at any stage of recruitment. Candidates must follow all social distancing rules and come wearing a mask.

content_sections.heading: About Burari Hospital
content_sections.text: Burari Hospital is a 768-bedded hospital of the Government of NCT of Delhi at Kaushik Enclave, Delhi. It started as a dedicated COVID hospital in 2020, and its general non-Covid services started in 2022. According to the notice, the hospital has a 50-bedded ICU, OTs and laboratories, its own oxygen supply, and serves an urban and rural population of about 10 lakh.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The 16 Senior Resident posts are split between two departments. Both posts have the same qualification, age limit and pay rule, which are given below the table. The number of posts is provisional and may change without any notice. Seats will be reserved for SC, ST, OBC (Delhi NCL) and differently abled candidates as per the prevailing Govt. Rules. If no reserved-category candidates are available, candidates from other categories would be considered on an ad-hoc basis for 44 days. MBBS with Post graduate degree/DNB/Diploma or equivalent as per Residency Scheme in the concerned specialty from a recognized University/Institute on the day of interview. If the MD/DNB certificate is not available, candidates who have 02 years of experience in the concerned department will be considered for the post on an ad-hoc basis. Candidates must not have completed 03 years as Senior Resident in any recognized institute, either regular or ad-hoc. Candidates must be registered with Delhi Medical Council (with MBBS and the requisite postgraduate qualification) on or before the day of interview. They should have a valid DMC certificate, or should have applied for the DMC registration of their PG Degree/Diploma, on the date of interview. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, see the official notification. If fresh candidates are not available, candidates who have already done three years of SR Residency in any Govt./Govt. aided institution will also be considered under Relaxed Norms. They will be selected under the relaxed eligibility criteria in circular No F.No 212/26/2010/H&FW/1996-2045 dated 10.06.2011 of Health and Family Welfare, Delhi Govt. Fresh candidates and candidates shortlisted under the relaxed criteria will be placed on separate lists. Candidates selected under the relaxed category will be appointed on an ad-hoc basis for 44 days. The age limit is a maximum of 45 years as on the date of interview, as per order no F.No.DHF&W/Q015/57/2016-HR-Medical-Secy(H&FW)CDno#11245060/1502-08 dated 26 November 2020. Only OBC candidates belonging to Delhi (Non creamy layer) will be considered for an OBC seat. They need a Delhi OBC (Non creamy) certificate issued in the current financial year. Pay will be in accordance with the 7th CPC guidelines as adopted by GNCT of Delhi. The notice does not print a pay level or amount. The appointment and services will be governed by the Residency Scheme. The appointment will be for an initial period of 44 days or till a regular candidate joins. It can be extended up to a maximum of three years on the basis of a satisfactory Work & Conduct report from the concerned HOD and a written request from the SR concerned. The total tenure of a Senior Resident will be a maximum of three years, including any senior residency done in another govt. / govt. funded institution. Either party can end the contract of appointment by giving one month's notice, without giving any reason. A panel of wait-listed candidates will be prepared

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The printout of the prefilled application form from the auto-generated email Two passport-size photos Self-attested photocopies of the required documents Original documents for verification The notice asks for these documents, in original with self-attested photocopies, in the following order: X class certificate (for Date of Birth) Attempt Certificate Degree (MBBS & Post graduate degree/ DNB or Diploma) Experience certificate, if applicable Aadhaar Card/ Voter ID/ Passport Publications (indexed journal only) OBC candidates must also bring a Delhi OBC (Non creamy) certificate issued in the current financial year.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Report at the Office of Medical Director, Burari Hospital between 9.00 AM and 11.00 AM. Entry will be allowed only up to 11 AM. A Google Map location is given in the notice: https://goo.gl/maps/EZNBWNJpZRz21DbV6 Your documents will be verified against the originals before the interview. A candidate who applies under the OBC category but cannot give valid proof at this stage will be rejected and will not be allowed to take the interview. Selection will be purely on the merit list based on the walk-in interview. The decision of the Selection Board/Medical Director of Burari Hospital will be final and binding, and no representation will be entertained. The result will be displayed on the Delhi Government website and the notice board. No letter or personal information will be issued. A candidate who accepts the offer must join within the time stated in the offer of appointment. Shortlisted candidates must also get their documents verified in the hospital on the day of joining. If a holiday is declared on a scheduled interview date, the interview will shift to the next working day or as decided by the Medical Director.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for taking part in the selection process. Every appointment will be subject to medical fitness and to verification of certificates of educational qualification, age and caste, and submission of a valid DMC post-graduation registration certificate. If any declaration or information is found to be false, or any fact is wilfully hidden, the candidature or appointment will be cancelled or terminated at once. Administrative or legal action will follow, and the Delhi Medical Council will also be informed. Candidature will be rejected if any discrepancy is found in documents or information at any stage of recruitment. Candidates must follow all social distancing rules and come wearing a mask.

faq.question: Q1. When is the Burari Hospital Senior Resident walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews will be held on every Friday from 30 October 2026 to 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Report between 9 AM and 11 AM at the Office of Medical Director, Burari Hospital, Kaushik Enclave, Burari, Delhi-110084. Entry is allowed only up to 11 AM.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in Burari Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 16 Senior Resident posts: 10 in OBG (UR 03, OBC 04, SC 03, ST 00) and 6 in Gen. Surgery (UR 02, OBC 01, SC 02, ST 01). The number of posts is provisional.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Burari Hospital Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates need MBBS with a Post graduate degree/DNB/Diploma or equivalent as per the Residency Scheme in the concerned specialty, from a recognized University/Institute, and Delhi Medical Council registration. If the MD/DNB certificate is not available, candidates with 02 years of experience in the concerned department will be considered on an ad-hoc basis.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit, and who gets age relaxation?
faq.answer: The age limit is a maximum of 45 years as on the date of interview. SC and ST candidates get a relaxation of up to 05 years, and OBC candidates (Non Creamy Layer belonging to Delhi only) get 3 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a Senior Resident at Burari Hospital?
faq.answer: Pay will be in accordance with the 7th CPC guidelines as adopted by GNCT of Delhi.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring the printout of the prefilled application form, two passport-size photos, and these documents in original with self-attested copies: X class certificate, Attempt Certificate, Degree (MBBS & Post graduate degree/ DNB or Diploma), experience certificate if applicable, Aadhaar Card/ Voter ID/ Passport, and publications (indexed journal only).

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be purely on the merit list based on the walk-in interview, after documents are verified on the same day. The result will be displayed on the Delhi Government website and the notice board.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Burari Hospital Senior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is an ad-hoc appointment under the Residency Scheme, initially for 44 days or till a regular candidate joins. It can be extended up to a maximum of three years based on a satisfactory Work & Conduct report and a written request from the SR.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates who have already completed three years of Senior Residency attend?
faq.answer: Yes, but only under Relaxed Norms and only if fresh candidates are not available. They will be on a separate list and, if selected, will be appointed on an ad-hoc basis for 44 days.
